treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of Norway and the State of Israel for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and capital (1966)
eif_quote: Lovdata: Avtalens ikrafttredelsesdato 11-01-1968 | Art. 31(2): The Convention shall enter into force upon the exchange of instruments of ratification and its provisions shall have effect: a) In the case of Israel: in respect of Israeli taxes for the tax years beginning on or after the first day of April, 1965 ...; b) In the case of Norway: (1) in respect of taxes on income, as to income acquired during the calendar year of 1965 ...
source_title: St.prp. nr. 78 (1966-67), Vedlegg: Convention Norway-Israel 1966 (English authentic text + Norwegian translation) in Stortingsforhandlinger 1966/67 vol. 2, digitised by the National Library of Norway (Lovdata carries metadata only)

rates.quote: provided that where the resident of Israel is a company which controls, directly or indirectly, at least 50 per cent of the entire voting power of the company paying the dividends, the rate of Norwegian tax shall not exceed 5 per cent.
a) The rate of Norwegian tax on dividends paid to a resident of Israel shall not exceed 15 per cent;
b) The tax on dividends paid by an Israeli company to a resident of Norway shall not exceed the rate of 25 per cent of such dividend.

2. However, such interest may be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the law of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 25 per cent of the amount of the interest.

1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State; however, the Contracting State in which the royalties arise may tax such royalties according to its own laws but the rate of tax shall not exceed 10 per cent of such royalties.

ppt.basis: none (no PPT in treaty; MLI not applicable to this pair)

notes: Dividend caps are direction-specific: Norwegian dividends 15% (5% where an Israeli company controls >=50% of voting power, directly or indirectly); Israeli dividends 25% in all cases. Retroactive effect: Norway income year 1965, Israel tax years from 1 April 1965 (interest/royalty valid_from set to 1965-01-01; Israeli-source effect 1965-04-01). Text obtained from the official parliamentary bill (OCR of National Library scan); Lovdata has metadata only. Not MLI-covered: Israel lists Norway but Norway does not list Israel.
